compiled_by: Auditor B (Claude Fable) from four scout lanes (E1 large solar, E2 battery storage, E3 wind, E4 smaller solar)
how_to_read: Each event is a real UK event with at least one source the scout opened; "opened_by_auditor" marks the sources the auditor opened again today.
Titles, links, dates and publishers only. No article text.
"repd_reference" is the register row the reviewers believe the event concerns (October 2026 REPD). It is context for testing, not a published match.

"rule_outcome" is what the rule in force allows from the headlines alone: "possible_match" (exact site name in a headline plus one agreeing field, one REPD row), "ambiguous" (exact name, more than one REPD row), or "none" (show the headline with no project).
Test for the algorithm: every headline listed here from a feed it reads must be kept; only "possible_match" events may carry a project, always labelled as a possible match.
